author: ai
text: No new orange or red disaster alerts were issued and no national-scale internet outages began this week. In the World Bank's Pink Sheet, natural gas in Europe averaged $28.5 per MMBtu in October 2026, up 12.1% on September 2026 and up 161.7% on October 2025. US hard red winter wheat averaged $317 per tonne, down 8.6% on September 2026. Copper averaged $14,508 per tonne in October 2026, up 0.2% on the month, and gold $4,105 per troy oz, down 5%. On the United States SDN list and Entity List, 79 entries were added and none removed this week; added entries most often give an address or nationality in Cambodia, India and Canada. The UK Sanctions List and the EU Financial sanctions file had no entries added or removed.
